1 +92.0 Deliberately struck coop board: M05 was seeking
protection.
2 +104.0 Aid interrupted: injured opening victims and
helpers.
3 +125.0 Tavern refuge / activity interrupted by a sensed
concentration.
4 +110.9 Farm escape test: local boundary contact, then
warning/retreat.
5 +213.9 Guard retreat and chosen object strikes preserve
personal recognition.
6 +258.5 Western shelter: people arriving from separate
intentions gather.
7 +313.9 Mayor secured; village sound continues during
helpless waiting.
8 +343.0 Church refuge: bell and grouped shelter become
vulnerable.
9 +368.1 Eastern household: late pressure corridor through
the occupied bay.

Old asset names such as CrushedHome are identifiers,
not proof of pre-existing massacre destruction.
